---
title: "大数据数据库入门心得"
format: html
---

查询平台上所有数据库信息蓝图

```{sql}
SELECT * FROM information_schema.schemata;
```

查看所有数据库

```{sql}
SELECT
    schema_name
FROM information_schema.schemata
ORDER BY schema_name;
```

查看所有表

```{sql}
SELECT
    table_schema,
    table_name
FROM information_schema.tables
ORDER BY table_schema,
         table_name;
```

查看某个 Schema

```{sql}
SELECT
    table_name
FROM information_schema.tables
WHERE table_schema='ods_mariadb_2b'
ORDER BY table_name;
```

查看所有字段

```{sql}
SELECT
    table_schema,
    table_name,
    ordinal_position,
    column_name,
    data_type,
    column_type,
    is_nullable,
    column_key,
    extra,
    column_comment
FROM information_schema.columns
ORDER BY
    table_schema,
    table_name,
    ordinal_position;
```

添加一列正名

```{sql}
WITH conflict_check AS (
    -- 找出"同一个column_name，在不同表里column_comment不一样"的冲突字段
    -- (排除id/status/type这类通用字段名——不同表本来就该不同，不算陷阱，
    --  跟之前R/Python版本用的排除清单完全一致)
    SELECT column_name
    FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'ods_mariadb_2b'   -- 视实际要查的库调整
      AND column_name NOT IN (
          '__source_pk','dt','source_db','source_table','ods_table_name','sync_time',
          'id','status','type','name','time','remark','code','currency','sn',
          'operator','url','money','addtime','lastmodifytime','ip','category','gid','mid'
      )
    GROUP BY column_name
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT column_comment) > 1
)
SELECT
    c.table_schema,
    c.table_name,
    c.ordinal_position,
    c.column_name,
    c.data_type,
    c.column_type,
    c.is_nullable,
    c.column_key,
    c.extra,
    c.column_comment,
    CASE
        -- 已在方案里标准化使用的字段(对照qmd 1.5节构建global_data的真实映射)
        WHEN c.table_name='ods_a168_bet02' AND c.column_name='bet01' THEN '✅bet_id(注單編號)'
        WHEN c.table_name='ods_a168_bet02' AND c.column_name='bet02' THEN '✅game_type(遊戲類別編號)'
        WHEN c.table_name='ods_a168_bet02' AND c.column_name='bet05' THEN '✅player_id(會員編號)'
        WHEN c.table_name='ods_a168_bet02' AND c.column_name='bet08' THEN '✅start_time(下注時間)'
        WHEN c.table_name='ods_a168_bet02' AND c.column_name='bet13' THEN '✅bet_amount(下注金額)'
        WHEN c.table_name='ods_a168_bet02' AND c.column_name='bet14' THEN '✅win_amount(派彩)'
        WHEN c.table_name='ods_a168_bet02' AND c.column_name='bet39' THEN '✅table_id(桌子編號)'
        WHEN c.table_name='ods_a168_bet02' AND c.column_name='eid'   THEN '✅dealer_id(荷官)'
        WHEN c.table_name='ods_a168_bet01' AND c.column_name='bet14' THEN '✅退水％數(注意:與bet02同編號但含義不同,非win_amount)'
        WHEN c.table_name='ods_a168_bet01' AND c.column_name='bet30' THEN '✅取消單(注意:與bet02同編號但含義不同,非LV3退水%數)'
        WHEN c.table_name='ods_a168_bet01' AND c.column_name='bet31' THEN '✅桌子編號(注意:bet02的table_id用的是bet39)'
        WHEN c.table_name='ods_a168_payment_order' AND c.column_name='mid' THEN '✅player_id候選橋接欄位(數值型mid,尚未實測驗證覆蓋率)'
        WHEN c.table_name='ods_a168_wallet_dtl' AND c.column_name='user' THEN '✅帳號字串(已實測與player_id交集0%,不可直接join)'
        -- 同名异义冲突字段：标明是哪张表专属含义
        WHEN cc.column_name IS NOT NULL THEN
            CONCAT('⚠️[', c.table_name, '专属]',
                   TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(c.column_comment,''), '^source_type=[^;]*;\\s*', '')))
        -- 其余：清掉技术前缀，只留人看得懂的说明；没注释的就标"未注释"
        ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(c.column_comment,''), '^source_type=[^;]*;\\s*', '')), '')
    END AS 正名
FROM information_schema.columns c
LEFT JOIN conflict_check cc ON cc.column_name = c.column_name
WHERE c.table_schema = 'ods_mariadb_2b'
ORDER BY c.table_schema, c.table_name, c.ordinal_position;
```

查看索引

```{sql}
SELECT * FROM information_schema.statistics;
```

查看主键

```{sql}
SELECT * FROM information_schema.key_column_usage;
```

第一版：扫描全部 ODS 表的同名字段

在 Superset SQL Lab / StarRocks 中可以先用这一版：

```{sql}

SELECT
    column_name,

    COUNT(DISTINCT table_name) AS table_count,

    GROUP_CONCAT(
        DISTINCT CONCAT(
            table_name,
            ' → ',
            COALESCE(column_comment, '无字段注释')
        )
        SEPARATOR ' | '
    ) AS definitions

FROM information_schema.columns

WHERE table_schema = 'ods_mariadb_2b'

GROUP BY
    column_name

HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT table_name) > 1

ORDER BY
    table_count DESC,
    column_name;
```
